segments.text: The main character of the setting; a first year and the only female student of Hakuou Academy. With an invitation from childhood friend Toudou, she resolves to enroll in the institution. She lost her parents at an early age and has since been living with Yukimura Koudou, a distant relative. She has a twin brother called Nagumo Kaoru, who lives separately in another family. Their relationship has been estranged then.
From Hakuouki Wiki

The Homeroom Teacher of Second Year, Form One, who teaches the Classics and is also a Disciplinarian Adviser. He acts on behalf of Kondou as an Assistant Principal presiding over most of the school management and is a childhood friend of Kondou as well. In his varsity years, he is Kazama's classmate and till now, is still at loggerheads with him. Hijikata currently lives alone in a mansion near the school and is a habitual smoker.
From Hakuouki Wiki

A Second Year, Form One student from the Kendo Club who loves making fun of people. Due to his weak constitution since young, he took up kendo to train himself. Another reason, was due to the guidance from Kondou, whom he looks up to as an elder brother. Adversely, he is sworn enemies with Hijikata. His latest obsession is smartphone photography and image editing.
From Hakuouki Wiki
A Second Year, Form Two student and a member of the Discipline Committee. Has a quiet nature and holds respect for Hijikata. Together with Okita and Toudou, he belongs to the Kendo Club.
From Hakuouki Wiki

A Second Year, Form One student who belongs to the Kendo Club. He lives as a neighbor of the Yukimuras and grew up with Chizuru as a childhood friend since young. He likes games but above all, he loves kendo.
From Hakuouki Wiki
The Health & Physical Education teacher, whose frank personality wins him a high popularity among students.
From Hakuouki Wiki

A mysterious Third Year, Form Three student and the president of the Student Council. In spite of being an university graduate, he enrolls in Hakuou Academy. He's a former university classmate of Hijikata and is not on good terms. He makes full use of his authority in the Student Council, owning most of the property in the Student Council's room and wears a custom-made uniform.
From Hakuouki Wiki
Despite his tracksuit attire, Shinpachi teaches Math & Science at Hakuou Academy & He is just as vivacious & boisterous as is his Edo period counterpart.
From Hakuouki Wiki

The founder, head principal & Kendo coach of Hakuou academy, He has an easygoing personality and is kind, thoughtful & very passionate about the well being of his students, however he seems to have a bad habit of training in the halls. He lives in a deserted dojo as his home.
From Hakuouki Wiki

The adoptive son of PTA Chairman Serizawa Kamo and classmate of Chizuru, who always eats anpan and milk. Due to being cash-strapped, he makes little earning by being a Jack-of-all-trades in school. He has his own shop at the entrance of the rooftop.
From Hakuouki Wiki
One of the financial contributors during the founding of the academy and the adoptive father of Ryunosuke. He serves as the Chairman of the PTA as well.
From Hakuouki Wiki
He serves in the management of the academy, as well as the school health physician. A person of calm demeanor.
From Hakuouki Wiki
A Second Year, Form Two student who works under Sannan in the Health Committee. Seemed previously to be at loggerheads with Ryunosuke. Respects Hijikata.
From Hakuouki Wiki
A First Year, Form Two student and the twin brother of Chizuru. He serves in the Discipline Committee.
From Hakuouki Wiki

An old friend of Chizuru, who is worried about her ever since her enrollment in an all boys academy. She comes from an established family dealing with tea ceremony. A student from Shimabara Girls' High School.
From Hakuouki Wiki

The first of Kazama's attendants, who always follows behind him and has a calm, composed personality. Although he is not really of an age to be a high school student, he was forcibly made to accompany Kazama when he re-entered high school.

The second of Kazama's attendants, who always follows behind him. Compared to Amagiri, his attitude toward Kazama is rather careless. Although he is not really of an age to be a high school student, he was forcibly made to accompany Kazama when he re-entered high school.
President of Inoue Construction, and also the "cafeteria uncle" at Hakuou Academy.
He is an old acquaintance of Kondou's, and has provided all kinds of assistance since the academy's founding up to the present day.
A highly trusted janitor who does even troublesome tasks without complaint.
He is a kind-hearted good person through and through. He truly embodies being gentle and strong.
Additionally, he loves sweets.
Sen's foster sister. A First Year student of Shimabara Girls' High. She has lived with the Suzuka family since a tender age after being picked up by them.
From Hakuouki Wiki
